Enumeration case with no producer: the guarded sum names the certificate it ATTEMPTED, and every attempt in the library is Nilpotent, Idempotent or FieldResolvent. A divisibility window is locally finite but reports the nilpotence it observed, so LocallyFinite is still issued nowhere, and None is the absence of any issued certificate rather than a certificate itself.
